comments.comment: publishReview now resumes every publish task a crash left and waits for it, but those tasks post the revision in their own input without checking the pull request still has that base, so a retargeted pull request gets the review of its old diff.
comments.failureScenario: Publishing A..H to pull request #7 crashes after the task is created and before its post. The parent lands and #7 is retargeted onto main, keeping head H; the maintainer reviews B..H and publishes. The new loop resumes the old task, whose input still names A..H: it finds no marker for A..H and posts A..H's review, with findings on the parent's code, to #7. Then the new task posts B..H's review as well.
